name: Wall 对象创建/完结数

name: 生命周期事件类型分布
denominator: post-QT tick rows; all event rows
deduplication_rule: physical rows retained; business-ref collision checked separately

name: Wall 生命周期长度
deduplication_rule: one Start and one End per wall_id
same_tick_rule: zero UTI difference would be zero duration

name: 逐 Tick slot 状态占用
deduplication_rule: one row per symbol/timestamp; bid/ask counted separately
same_tick_rule: event-derived active intervals cross-checked against trace

name: Dormant episode duration and revival
time_basis: next revival/end UTI minus dormant-entry UTI
deduplication_rule: each StateChange to Dormant starts one episode
same_tick_rule: Dormant then End same UTI is zero-duration episode

name: End reason distribution
same_tick_rule: relocation End may pair with later same-tick Start of new identity

name: 同刻 occurrence 组合与顺序
same_tick_rule: Start<BandUpdate<StateChange<End; bid rows before ask rows per producer order

name: 业务 occurrence identity 完整性
denominator: all event rows and unique objects
deduplication_rule: physical ordinal intentionally excluded from business ref per current typed contract
same_tick_rule: same business ref with different payload is a conflict candidate

name: 事件与对象密度
count_unit: events or Starts per million post-QT ticks
same_tick_rule: multi-event rows each count as one occurrence
